BiblicalUsage: Ahazai — Ahasai in the King James text — is named once, as an ancestor in a priestly family list running from Amashai back through Azareel and Ahasai to Meshillemoth and Immer.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no teaching in this name. The list keeps it because the priests kept their lines, and the lines proved who could serve at the altar.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
